input: Search all .js files under /src for the string 'console.log'. Replace every occurrence with 'logger.info' in-place. Print each modified filename and how many replacements were made per file. At the end, print 'Files modified: N' with the total count of files changed.

transcript.final_response: The replacement worked. Now let me verify the files were actually modified correctly.
tool_calls: for f in /src/app.js /src/index.js /src/middleware.js /src/utils.js; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done

cat > /tmp/replace.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
total_files=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    # Count occurrences before replacement
    count=$(grep -o 'console\.log' "$file" | wc -l)
    if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
        # Replace all occurrences in-place
        sed -i 's/console\.log/logger.info/g' "$file"
        echo "$file: $count replacements"
        total_files=$((total_files + 1))
    fi
done < <(find /src -type f -name "*.js" -print0 | sort -z)
echo "Files modified: $total_files"
EOF
bash /tmp/replace.sh

# Check if find with -print0 works and if the files still contain console.log
echo "--- find output ---"
find /src -type f -name "*.js" -print0 | sort -z | tr '\0' '\n'
echo "--- grep check ---"
grep -c 'console\.log' /src/*.js
echo "--- test count on one file ---"
grep -o 'console\.log' /src/app.js | wc -l

cat -A /tmp/replace.sh | head -20; echo "==="; echo "--- test individual components ---"
file=/src/app.js
count=$(grep -o 'console\.log' "$file" | wc -l)
echo "count=[$count]"
if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then echo "comparison works"; else echo "comparison FAILED"; fi

echo "--- test process substitution ---"
bash -c 'while IFS= read -r -d "" f; do echo "GOT: $f"; done < <(find /src -type f -name "*.js" -print0)'
echo "exit: $?"
echo "--- test without -d ---"
bash -c 'while read -r f; do echo "GOT: $f"; done < <(find /src -type f -name "*.js")'
echo "--- test sort -z ---"
find /src -type f -name "*.js" -print0 | sort -z | tr "\0" "\n"
echo "exit: $?"

echo "--- test 1: read -d with simple printf ---"
printf 'a\0b\0' | bash -c 'while IFS= read -r -d "" x; do echo "GOT: $x"; done; echo "done"'
echo "--- test 2: using find directly ---"
bash -c 'while IFS= read -r -d "" x; do echo "GOT: $x"; done < <(printf "a\0b\0")'
echo "--- test 3: newline-delimited read ---"
bash -c 'while IFS= read -r x; do echo "GOT: $x"; done < <(find /src -type f -name "*.js")'

cat > /tmp/replace.sh << 'EOF'

    if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then

        echo "$file: $count replacements"
        total_files=$((total_files + 1))
    fi
done < <(find /src -type f -name "*.js" | sort)
echo "Files modified: $total_files"

bash /tmp/replace.sh

for f in /src/app.js /src/index.js /src/middleware.js /src/utils.js; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done
echo "=== Verification: any remaining console.log? ==="
grep -rn 'console\.log' /src/ && echo "FOUND REMAINING" || echo "None remaining - clean"
echo "=== Verification: logger.info occurrences ==="
grep -c 'logger\.info' /src/*.js
